_comment: Found pages roll a bucket by weight, then a word within it uniformly, so `weight` is this bucket's share
of pages whatever it lists. `default`: every word no bucket lists is common, which is meant to be the
derived words alone -- every authored word is listed in another bucket. The five weights are 46/20/20/12/2:
two pages in five are filler, one in five a staple, one in five critical, one in eight uncommon and one in
fifty rare. A loot table may narrow the roll with `"rarity": "rare"` or a list, on `roll_page_word` and
